blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A patient who has lost part of the skull vault needs an implant that fits the defect exactly, and such implants are still drawn by hand in CAD by specialists, which makes each case slow and expensive. The task can be considered as a shape completion problem, so pretrained completion models, and now the first shape completion foundation models, look like a way to remove that manual step. We audited three publicly released pretrained shape completion models, two of them foundation models, applied zero-shot to 239 cranial defects, some carved from public skull datasets and some real post-craniectomy cases. Each output was compared with simply returning the patient's own remaining bone, and tested for whether the predicted material could be placed without intersecting the bone that is still there. On the 210 carved defects none of the three improved on doing nothing, and on the 29 real cases only one did so beyond chance. Yet not one output, from any model in any configuration, was implantable: none managed both to stay clear of the bone the patient still has and to place more material than doing nothing, where a task-specific volumetric model, trained for this task and selected on these cases, was implantable on all but one. The output that most convincingly resembles a skull is no more placeable than the rest, and at these point densities implant thickness cannot be read off the emitted points at all, which is a property of the output representation rather than of any one model. On this evidence the shape completion foundation models we could obtain cannot be trusted and, used as released, are not usable in clinical practice. Substantial research towards trustworthy foundation models for shape completion is still needed.
blocks.zh: 失去部分头骨金库的病人需要一个完全适合缺陷的植入物,这种植入物仍然由专家在CAD中手取出,这使得每个病例都缓慢而昂贵. 任务可以被认为是形状完成问题,所以预先训练的完成模型,现在的第一个形状完成基础模型,看起来像是去除那个人工步骤的方法. 我们审计了3个公开发布的预先训练的外形完成模型,其中2个是基础模型,对239个颅骨缺陷应用了零镜头,有些是从公共头骨数据集中雕刻出来的,还有一些是真正的脑后切除病例. 每一次输出都与简单的还原患者自己所剩的骨骼相比较,并测试预测出的物质能否被放入而不与尚存的骨骼相交叉. 在210个被雕刻出来的缺陷上,三个都没有改进过无所事事,在29个真正的案例中,只有一个没有机会这样做。 然而,从任何配置中的任何模型来看,没有一个产出是能够被植入的:除了一个模型外,没有一种模型既能够远离病人的骨骼,又能够放置比无所事事更多的材料,因为只有一个模型能够植入一个特定的任务体积模型。 最令人信服地类似于头骨的输出不会比其他的更能被取而代之,在这个时候,密度的植入厚度完全不能从所发射的点上读取,这是输出代表而不是任何一个模型的属性. 根据这些证据,我们所能获得的形状完成基础模型是无法信任的,而且作为释放物使用,在临床实践中无法使用。 仍需要进行大量研究,以建立可靠的基础模型来完成形状。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
After a decompressive craniectomy, a head injury or a tumour resection that takes bone, a patient
is left with an opening in the skull vault, closed with an implant shaped to that patient’s
anatomy [ 11 , 9 ] . The implant should protect the brain and restore
the original shape of the skull, and whether it fits is settled in the operating
room [ 10 , 12 ] .
blocks.zh:
骨切除、头部损伤或肿瘤复剖后,患者
在头盖骨保险库里留下一个开口 用一个植入器关闭 形状为病人的
解剖学 [11, 9]. 植入物应保护大脑并恢复
头骨的原始形状,以及是否适合在操作中解决
[10,12]室。

blocks.en:
Such implants are designed by hand, in CAD, by specialists, which makes each case slow and
expensive and limits how many patients can be offered one. Automation has been pursued for a
decade, mostly as volumetric completion of the missing bone, and networks trained for that task now
do well on public benchmarks [ 11 , 9 , 12 ] , most
recently point-cloud diffusion and flow
matching [ 5 , 8 , 7 ] . Every one of them has to be trained
on data for the task, and that is the cost a foundation model promises to remove.
blocks.zh:
此类植入物由专家在CAD中手动设计,使每个病例缓慢,
价格昂贵,并且限制了有多少病人可以得到治疗。 已进行自动化
十年,主要作为 体积完成缺失的骨头, 和网络培训 现在的任务
在公共基准方面做得好 [11、9、12],大多数
最近点云的传播和流动
匹配 [5, 8, 7] 。 他们每个人都要接受训练
,这是一个基础模型有望消除的成本。

blocks.en:
Foundation models are becoming increasingly popular in medical
imaging [ 17 , 28 ] , and the first of them aimed at shape completion are now
appearing [ 25 , 14 ] . A skull with a defect is a partial shape and the implant
completes it, so implant design is close to what these models advertise [ 13 ] , and
a checkpoint used as it comes would remove both the training data and the manual step.
blocks.zh:
基础模型在医学界越来越流行
成像[17,28], 其中第一个旨在完成形状的现在
[25、14]。 有缺陷的头骨是部分形状和植入
完成它,所以植入设计接近 这些模型广告[13],和
如有检查站,将删除培训数据和人工步骤。

blocks.en:
Completion models are judged by how closely the completed shape resembles a reference, and that
resemblance is not what a surgeon needs to know: it cannot say whether the model added anything the
patient’s own bone did not already supply, nor whether what it predicted could physically be placed
in that patient [ 16 , 15 , 24 ] .
blocks.zh:
完成模型是根据完成的形状与参考物相似程度来判断的,而且
相似性不是外科医生需要知道的:不能说模型是否添加了什么
病人自己的骨骼没有供应,也无法将预言放在身体上
该病人[16,15,24]。

blocks.en:
Contribution: We audit three publicly released pretrained shape completion models, applied
zero-shot to cranial defects, and judge them by what the clinic needs rather than by what a
benchmark reports. First, we score every output against an explicit do-nothing baseline,
the patient’s own retained bone. Second, we introduce a physical acceptance criterion, under which
the predicted material must sit in the defect without intersecting the bone that remains, and we
report how many patients could receive each output. Third, we test whether the language
conditioning these models advertise carries anatomical information, reading each against its own
noise floor. Together they let a completion model be judged on the thing that decides its
use: whether what it produced could be put in a patient.
blocks.zh:
贡献: 我们审计了3个公开发布的 预先训练的形状完成模型
对颅骨缺陷的零射线进行判断,并按诊所需要什么来判断,而不是按
基准报告。 首先,我们得分每个产出 与一个明确的无所事事的基准,
病人自己留下的骨头。 第二,我们采用物理接受标准,根据这些标准,
预言的物质必须坐落在缺陷中 而不交叉 留下的骨头,我们
报告每个产出可接收多少病人。 第三,我们测试语言是否
这些模型的广告带有解剖学信息, 逐个读取自己的
噪音地板。 他们一起让一个完成模型 被判断在决定它的事情
使用:它生产的东西是否可以放进病人体内。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Automatic cranial implant design has been posed mainly as volumetric completion of the missing
bone. The AutoImplant challenges established the task over SkullBreak and SkullFix, whose defects
are carved synthetically from complete CT
skulls [ 11 , 9 , 6 ] , and networks trained for it handle
those defects well [ 12 ] ; MUG500+ later added real craniectomy cases with their
manufactured implants [ 10 ] . These set the standard a zero-shot checkpoint has to meet.
blocks.zh:
自动颅内植入设计主要作为失物的体积完成
骨头。 自动植入挑战确定了SkullBreak和SkullFix的任务,它们的缺陷
从完整的CT中合成出来
颅骨[11、9、6],以及为其操作而训练的网络
这些缺陷良好 [12];MUG500+后来增加了真正的胸切除病例及其
人工植入[10]。 这些设定了零射门检查站必须达到的标准.

blocks.en:
Shape completion infers a complete shape from a partial observation [ 27 ] . We audit
every released model we could obtain that performs it without task training: the two offered at
or advertised at foundation scale, and one strong generalist as a non-medical control. AdaPoinTr is a strong pretrained generalist trained
on ShapeNet-55, whose 55 everyday object categories include no
skull [ 26 , 2 ] . MSN-FM describes itself as the first multi-modal
foundation model for medical point cloud completion and takes its text through a BERT
encoder [ 25 , 13 , 3 ] . MGPC, a more recent preprint, keeps a text branch
and adds an image branch, both read from frozen encoders [ 14 , 20 , 18 ] ; it
makes both modalities optional at inference, though its released code provides no such path, so an
image must always be supplied. MSN-FM is advertised as a foundation model and MGPC is trained at
that scale. Surveys of 3D point cloud foundation models reach neither of
them [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh:
形状完成从局部观测推断出完整的形状[27]. 我们的审计
每一个发布的模型,我们可以得到 做到这一点,没有任务培训:
或以基金会规模的广告, 和一位强大的通才 作为非医疗控制。 AdaPoinTr是一个训练有素的全科医生
在 shapeNet-55 上,它的55个日常对象类别包括无
头骨 [26, 2]. MSN-FM将自己描述为第一种多式联运
医学点云完成的基础模型,并将其文本通过BERT
编码器 [25, 13, 3]. MGPC, 最近的预印本, 保留文本分支
并添加一个图像分支,从冷冻编码器读取[14,20,18];
虽然其发布的代码没有提供这种路径,但这两种模式都可以在推论中选择,因此
必须始终提供图像。 MSN-FM作为基础模型进行广告宣传,MGPC在下列地点接受培训:
尺码 对三维点云基模型的调查没有达到
[22]。

blocks.en:
The benchmarks they were built on report similarity to a reference, which is a poor match for a
clinical decision. Chamfer distance, the usual choice, is insensitive to mismatched point density
and heavily influenced by outliers [ 24 ] , and without a do-nothing baseline no benchmark
separates a model from the trivial solution [ 16 , 21 ] .
Completion trained on synthetic partials also degrades on real scans [ 19 ] . We
therefore fixed the baseline and the acceptance criterion before running a single model.
blocks.zh:
基准是建立在报告与参考文献相似的基础上的。
临床决定。 通常选择的凸轮距离对不匹配点密度不敏感
并且受到外部因素的严重影响 并且没有无动于衷的基准
将一个模型与琐碎的解决方案分开 [16, 21].
关于合成部分的完成培训也通过真实扫描降解[19]. 我们
因此,在运行单一模型之前,先确定基线和接受标准。

blocks.en: 3 Materials and Methods
blocks.zh: 3 材料和方法

blocks.en:
We work with 239 skulls: 210 held-out test cases of SkullBreak (100) and SkullFix (110), whose
defects are carved synthetically, and 29 real craniectomy defects from
MUG500+ [ 6 , 10 ] . The first two give the missing bone , the whole removed
volume including the diploe; MUG500+ gives the manufactured implant an expert designed for
that patient, so its results measure whether material went where the implant goes rather than
reconstruction accuracy.
blocks.zh:
我们与239个头骨合作:有210个悬浮试验病例的SkullBreak(100)和SkullFix(110)
29个真正的颅切除缺陷来自
MUG500+ [6, 10] (英语). 头两个给了缺失的骨头, 整个去除
体积,包括Diploe; MUG500+使人工植入物具有专为:
因此,它的结果 测量材料是否去 哪里植入,而不是
重建精确度。

blocks.en:
Every model receives the kept subset of one surface sample of the complete skull, split by
the missing-bone mask, so that input and reference come from a single draw. The median kept
subset holds 5955 points, reduced by farthest-point sampling to each architecture’s fixed input
size: 4096 for MSN-FM, 2048 for the other two. We measure recall of the removed region at 2 mm and report it as an advantage over a no-op, the per-skull difference against simply handing back the patient’s
retained bone. That baseline is not optional: the removed bone is a thin shell over the vault, so
proximity to retained bone supplies coverage for free [ 16 , 15 ] .
The tolerance is 2 mm because the task-specific model described below saturates at 5 mm and
still reaches 0.966 at 2 mm, so sparsity cannot excuse a coverage failure there.
blocks.zh:
每个模型都收到完整头骨一个表面样本的保存子集,由
缺少的骨面罩,所以输入和引用来自单图。 中位数保留
子集有5955个点, 将每个架构的固定输入减少最远点的采样
尺寸:MSN-FM4096,另两款为2048. 我们用2毫米的距离来测量被清除区域, 并报告它比一个不开放的优势, 即每个骷髅的区别,
留下的骨头。 基线不是可选的: 切除的骨头是金库上的薄壳,所以
接近保留骨料的免费保险[16,15].
耐力是2毫米,因为下面描述的任务特定型号为5毫米和5毫米饱和度。
仍然在2毫米时达到0.966, 因此,Sparsity不能原谅 覆盖失败在那里。

blocks.en:
Not every row spends its point budget the same way, so the headline table is not a like-for-like
comparison. A completion model spreads its points over a whole skull;
the task-specific reference emits the defect region alone, putting 2733 of its 6144 points inside
the removed region against 193 for an ideal uniform sample of a whole skull. That uniform resample is the
allocation-neutral row, and its median per-skull advantage is + 0.169 +0.169 .
Recall rises with point count, so every arm is scored at a common 6144-point budget and at its
native one; the two conventions agree on the ordering and flip AdaPoinTr’s sign ( + 0.013 +0.013 native, − 0.036 -0.036 common). Implantability is read at the common budget. Extra points can only help recall,
and because penetration is a maximum over points they can only hurt it, so the two conventions
pull in opposite directions.
blocks.zh:
并不是每一行都以同样的方式花点预算,所以头条表不是像
比较。 一个完成模型将它的分数分布在一整头颅上;
具体任务的参考文献仅显示缺陷区域,其中6144点中有2733点在其中。
切除区域对193 理想的统一样本 一个完整的头骨。 那个制服的复写是
分配中性行,其每个骷髅的中值优势为+0.169+0.169.
复召以点数升起,所以每个臂都得到6144分共同预算的得分
土生土长; 两项公约商定订购和翻转AdaPoinTr的标志(+ 0.013 + 0.013 土生土长,− 0.036 - 0.036 常见)。 可移植性在共同预算中阅读。 额外的分数只能帮助回忆,
并且因为渗透是最高的点数 他们只能伤害它,所以两个公约
向相反的方向拉动。

blocks.en:
A prediction is implantable if it is collision-free at a 1 mm tolerance against the
patient’s retained bone and its advantage over the no-op at 2 mm is non-negative. That is
a geometric screen and a necessary condition rather than a clinical approval: an output failing it
cannot be placed, while one passing it still has to satisfy everything a designer and a surgeon
check. The tolerance is 1 mm
because that is what the instrument resolves: on the 478 rows whose true penetration is zero by
construction it reads 0.533 mm at worst. That is a measurement floor, not a surgical requirement,
and nothing in the audited models’ verdict turns on it, their penetrations being ten times larger;
the reference row, at 0.55 mm, is the one row it does bind. The second condition earns its place because collision-freedom alone is
gameable: one swept configuration returned a skull 0.634 × 0.634\times the patient’s size, a median
26.4 mm from any bone. Headline numbers use the deployment frame, which places a model
from the defective skull alone; the training-time frame aligns to the complete skull,
unobtainable when that skull is the prediction.
blocks.zh:
如果在1毫米的耐受力下没有碰撞,则可以植入预测。
患者保留骨骼,其优于2毫米的无孔骨,是非负性的。 这是
几何显示屏和必要条件,而不是临床批准:产出失败
不能被放置,而一个通过它仍然 满足一切 设计者和外科医生
检查。 承受力是1毫米(5毫米)
因为这就是仪器所解决的: 在478行,其真正的穿透度为零
构造最糟糕时为0.533毫米。 这是一个测量底,不是手术要求,
被审计的模型的判断没有任何结果,它们的渗透率是十倍;
参考行,0.55毫米,是它确实捆绑的一行。 第二个条件之所以能占上风 是因为只有碰撞自由
游戏:一个扫描配置返回了头骨 0.634 × 0.634\ 病人大小, 中位数
26.4毫米 从任何骨头。 头条数字使用部署框架,其中设置一个模型
以有缺陷的头骨盟誓,
当那个头骨是预言时,是无法发现的。

blocks.en:
A task-specific volumetric model gives the criterion a scale: a 3D convolutional encoder–decoder
segments the missing bone and emits an implant mask, sampled to the same 6144 points and scored by
the same instrument. It was trained on the SkullBreak and SkullFix training splits,
disjoint from the test skulls, then selected as the best of 138 arms by Dice (0.916) on the same
210 carved cases it is reported on, so its row is a test-selected reference ceiling and not
an unbiased estimate, and the 29 real defects are out of domain for it. We built it ourselves, and it
is here for one reason rather than as a rival: without it a reader could not tell whether these
criteria can be met at all.
blocks.zh:
任务特定的量子模型给标准一个尺度: 3D 演化编码器 - 解码器
分解缺失的骨头并发出植入口罩,取样到同样的6144分,得分为:
同样的乐器。 它接受了"骷髅碎裂"和"骷髅碎裂"训练
与测试头骨脱节,然后被Dice(0.916)选为138臂中最好的一个
报告210个雕刻案,因此其行是测试选定的参考上限,而不是
和29个真正的缺陷 已经超出了它的范围。 我们自己建造的,它
这里只有一个原因,而不是作为竞争者:没有它,读者就无法知道这些是否
完全可以达到标准。

blocks.en:
The easier mistake here is to condemn a model that does not deserve it, so we spent the second
half of the study trying to break the first: we swept six protocol dimensions and added a positive
control handing each model the complete skull. One asymmetry is worth stating. MSN-FM’s and MGPC’s
checkpoints were accepted on reproducing upstream behaviour, AdaPoinTr’s on a weaker check that the
weights had loaded, because the ShapeNet-55 test split is not available. The source code is released
at [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh:
这里比较容易的错误是谴责一个不值得的模型, 所以我们花了第二个
半个研究试图打破第一个:我们扫荡了六个协议维度,并增加了一个积极的
控制每个模型 完整的头骨。 一个不对称的情况值得一提。 MSN-FM和MGPC的
AdaPoin,上游行为再现的检查站被接受 更糟糕的是,
重量已加载, 因为无法使用 ShapeNet-55 测试拆分 。 源代码发布
在[23]。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
Table 1 : Medians over 239 skulls at the common 6144-point budget, deployment frame. Advantage is
the per-skull gain in recall of the removed region at 2 mm over a no-op; implantable adds
collision-freedom at 1 mm. The controls pass by construction, not by merit, and the task-specific
row is ours and test-selected ( Sec. 3 ). 29 of the 239 are real craniectomy defects,
separated out in Tab. 2 .
blocks.zh:
表1:在共同的6144点预算,部署框架中,超过239个头骨的中间数. 优点是
可植入物增加
1毫米自由碰撞 控制通过建设,而不是通过功绩,以及具体任务
排队是我们的 测试选(第3节) 239个中29个是真正的颅切除缺陷
分离出塔布。 2 (英语).

blocks.en:
By the usual coverage score the models do not look broken. With the normalisation held fixed so that
only the defect process varies, MSN-FM recalls 0.462 of the removed region at 5 mm on the
carved defects, against 0.439 on the compact defect it was trained to repair. Coverage alone cannot say whether a model added anything at all.
blocks.zh:
按照通常的覆盖率,这些模型似乎没有破损。 固定了正常化状态
MSN-FM回顾到,除去的5毫米区域有0.462
雕刻的缺陷,而紧凑的缺陷是0.439,它接受了修理训练。 单是覆盖面不能说一个模型有没有增加任何东西。

blocks.en:
All three put less material within 2 mm of the missing bone than the patient’s own retained bone
already does ( Tab. 1 , Fig. 1 a): AdaPoinTr − 0.036 -0.036 ,
MGPC − 0.130 -0.130 and MSN-FM − 0.156 -0.156 , where the task-specific reference reaches + 0.745 +0.745 on an
allocation that is not like-for-like with theirs ( Sec. 3 ). Medical pretraining did not
help: MSN-FM is the worst of the three, behind one trained on 55 everyday object categories.
blocks.zh:
三个都比病人自己留下的骨骼 少了2毫米
(表1,图1a): AdaPoinTr - 0.036 - 0.036,
MGPC− 0.130-0.130和MSN-FM− 0.156-0.156,其中具体任务参考值达到+ 0.745+0.745
(第3款)。 医学预训没有
帮助:MSN-FM是最差的三部曲之一,后面有一个接受了55个日常对象类别的培训.

blocks.en:
The difference between a completion benchmark and a clinical defect lies in the baseline rather
than in the model. In that same comparison a model’s coverage barely moves across defect types,
while a no-op recovers
0.049 of the compact ball-shaped defect used in completion training and 0.783 of the dispersed
defects the skull datasets ship, both at 5 mm. What looks like competence on the released benchmark is mostly
the baseline.
blocks.zh:
完成基准与临床缺陷之间的区别在于基线。
比模特儿还要好 在同一比较中,一个模型的覆盖范围几乎不会跨越缺陷类型,
而不恢复时
0.049 完成训练时使用的紧凑球形缺陷和 0.783 分散的缺陷
使头骨数据集在5毫米处失效 似乎在发布基准上的能力主要是
基线。

reference, which is ours and test-selected ( Sec. 3 ); shaded band, the instrument’s
floor.

blocks.en:
Two things move the sign of the comparison with a no-op. At its native 8192-point budget AdaPoinTr
reaches + 0.013 +0.013 , which the budget sweep attributes to the extra points rather than better
content. So does the cohort ( Tab. 2 ): on the 29 real craniectomy defects MGPC
beats a no-op at + 0.118 +0.118 , on 24 of 29, while losing on the carved ones, and AdaPoinTr’s + 0.021 +0.021 there is not established. One model reversing on 29 skulls, against a manufactured implant, does
not settle the clinical question.

有两样东西移动了对比的标志 和无操作。 AdaPoinTr的8192点预算
达到 + 0.013 + 0.013 , 预算扫描属性为额外点而非更好
内容。 在29个真正的胸切除缺陷上,
以+ 0.118+ 0.118 的比分在 29 的 24 的比分中击败了禁赛,而AdaPoinTr 的 + 0.021 + 0.021 则没有建立. 一个在29个头骨上倒置的模型, 与人工植入物相对应,
没有解决临床问题。

blocks.en:
Seen on the patient all three cover the defect with material that reads as a completed skull
( Fig. 2 ), but only one returns a surface: 0.564 of AdaPoinTr’s points lie within 2 mm
of the true skull, against 0.108 and 0.043 for the others.

(图2),但只有一个返回表面:AdaPoin的0.564 点数在2毫米以内
真实的头骨,对0.108和0.043 其他人。

blocks.en:
Neither kind can be placed in the patient. Every model is implantable on 0 of 239 skulls, against 238 of 239
for the task-specific reference, which is collision-free on all of them; across the three, not one of 2868 model-arm-skull combinations is
collision-free at 1 mm ( Fig. 1 b). Misregistration does not account for that: the unobtainable
training-time frame moves penetration by Cliff’s δ = − 0.025 \delta=-0.025 ( p = 0.109 p=0.109 ) against a total
separation from the no-op ( δ = 1.000 \delta=1.000 ), so the collisions are in the shape of the output, not
in where it was put. Nor does the allocation: the ground-truth control spreads the same
6144 points over the same whole skull and collides on none of the 239 ( Tab. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
任何一种都不能放在病人身上。 每个模型都可以植入239个头骨中的0个,而239个头骨中的238个
用于特定任务的参考,即所有物体无碰撞; 跨越三个,而不是2868个模型-臂-骷髅组合中的一个是
1毫米时无碰撞(图1b)。 登记不当并不说明原因:
Cliff = 0.025\ delta=- 0.025(p = 0.109 p = 0.109)的训练时间框架移动渗透率,而总数
与无 Op 分离( δ = 1. 000\ delta = 1. 000),所以碰撞是输出的形状,而不是
放在原处 分配:地面真实控制也一样
同一头骨上的6144分,239个都没有碰撞(Tab. 1 ).

blocks.en:
At the point densities these models emit, implant thickness is not carried by the output at all,
whatever the model ( Fig. 3 ). A 6144-point sample of a skull has a mean nearest-neighbour spacing
of 2.56 mm, and at a comparable spacing of 2.4 mm, 0.447 of every neighbourhood on a 3 mm plate is drawn
from the opposite face, so the two faces are not separable and thickness cannot be read off the emitted
points [ 1 ] . Even a 5 mm plate is contaminated at 0.351, whereas at 0.4 mm
spacing it separates cleanly, which places the failure in the representation and not in the
measurement. The 3 mm floor is itself a design
target [ 4 ] that the clinical data violate, 11 of the 29 real MUG500+
implants being thinner than it ( Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh:
此时这些模型的密度 植入厚度根本不是输出所携带的
无论型号如何(图3),头骨的6144点样本都有最近的距离。
2.56毫米,在2.4毫米的可比间隔内,绘制3毫米板块上每个街区的0.447个;
从相反的面孔,所以两个面孔是不能分开的,厚度是不能从所射出的。
积分[1]. 甚至一个5毫米板块在0.351受到污染,而在0.4毫米受到污染
它的间隔是干净的,它把失败放在代表而不是在代表中。
计量。 3毫米楼层本身就是设计
临床数据违反的目标[4],29个真正的MUG500+中的11个
植入物比它薄(图3)。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 : How thin a plate can get before its two surfaces stop being distinguishable, at each
point budget in play (ideal even resample, no model, 239 skulls per box).
No budget the audited models emit or receive reaches 3 mm, so thickness is lost before a
model is asked to recover it. That
3 mm is a design target rather than a law, and the clinical data break it: 11 of the 29 real
MUG500+ implants (38 %) are thinner than 3 mm, the 29 having median 3.05 mm and mean 3.30 ± 1.41 3.30\pm 1.41 mm. The dashed box is AdaPoinTr’s other checkpoint ( Sec. 4 ).

点预算在游戏中(理想甚至再现,没有模型,每箱239头颅).
未经审计的模型没有排放或接收到的预算达到3毫米,因此厚度在一号模型之前丢失。
模型需要恢复。 那个
3mm是一个设计目标而不是定律,临床数据打破了它:29个真数中的11个
MUG500+植入物(38%)比3毫米薄,29个有中位数3.05毫米,平均值330±1.41-330\pm1.41毫米. AdaPoinTr的另一个检查站(第4条)。

blocks.en:
The other advertised capability is language, which only the two foundation models accept. Against
each model’s own no-information floor, every MGPC prompt moves the geometry 0.05 to 0.15 × \times as
much as a second blank image, and MSN-FM’s 0.49 to 1.08 × \times as much as a change of seed, so
most of MSN-FM’s prompt swaps do less than asking it twice. MSN-FM’s weights say why: its text branch ends in a ReLU, 97.5 % of the text code is exactly
zero, and a prompt moves the fused code by 8.8 % of the shape code’s norm. Across two text
encoders and two fusion mechanisms the channel is decorative in MGPC and, on all but one prompt,
in MSN-FM.
blocks.zh:
另一个被公布的能力是语言,只有两个基础模型接受. 反对
每个模型的无信息层,每个 MGPC 提示移动几何 0.05 到 0.15 ×\时为
而MSN-FM的0.49比1.08 ×\时间就像种子的改变,所以
大部分MSN-FM的即时互换比两次问要少. MSN-FM的权重表示: 它的文本分支以ReLU结尾,97.5%的文本代码是准确的
零, 并迅速将引信代码移动到形状代码规范的8.8% 。 横跨两个文本
编码器和两个聚变机制 信道在MGPC中是装饰性的,除了一个快速,
在 MSN-FM 中。

blocks.en:
None of this rests on protocol choices of ours. Presentation pose and input scale showed no effect on a
14-skull pilot, which at that size is weak evidence, and we do not read it as evidence of no
effect. Across all
six swept dimensions, no audited row is implantable. The one arm that
comes closest is instructive: AdaPoinTr’s other released checkpoint emits 16 384 points, twice the
largest audited budget and the only one that resolves a 3 mm plate
( Fig. 3 ), and it is collision-free on 1 of 239 skulls. It is also the worst arm
we ran, at − 0.198 -0.198 . Having enough points to represent an implant is not the same as producing one. Handed the
complete skull, AdaPoinTr clears a no-op at + 0.042 +0.042 and improves on its own default on 228 of 239
skulls, so a negative number is no artefact of our frame or input. MSN-FM ( − 0.151 -0.151 ) and MGPC
( − 0.124 -0.124 ) cannot return even a shape they were shown.
blocks.zh:
这一切都不取决于我们的协议选择。 演示文稿和输入比例表对
14个骷髅飞行员,那么小的体型是微弱的证据,我们不把它看成是没有的证据
效应。 包罗万象
6个横扫的维度,没有经过审核的行是可植入的. 单臂
来得最近,确是有启发性的: 阿达潘 Tr的另一个被放行的检查站发出16 384点,两倍于
最大的审计预算 解决3毫米板块的唯一预算
(图3),239个头骨中有1个没有碰撞。 也是最烂的手臂
我们在0.198-0.198跑步 有足够的分数来代表植入物与产生植入物不同。 交给了
完整的头骨, 阿达潘 Tr 在 + 0.042 + 0.042 时清除禁用, 并在 228 的 239 上自行改进
头骨,所以一个负数 不是一个动画 我们的框架或输入。 MSN-FM(−0.151-0.151)和MGPC
(− 0.124-0.124)甚至无法返回所显示的形状。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The models answer a different question from the one implant design asks, and thickness shows it.
Measuring it at all means turning an output into a solid, which we do with a 3 mm reconstruction
radius, identically for every method. What comes back barely moves: 5.40 to 5.93 mm for every
model on every cohort, against references spanning 3.05 to 7.25 mm. The number is our reconstruction
radius rather than their output, and that is the point: a surface has no thickness, so there is
nothing for the measurement to find, and no overlap metric here registers that.
blocks.zh:
模型回答了一个与植入式设计不同的问题,厚度也显示了这一点.
完全测量它意味着把输出变成固体, 我们用3毫米的重建
半径 每种方法都一样 回来的东西几乎不动:每件5.40至5.93毫米
每个组的模型,对介于3.05至7.25毫米之间的参考文献。 号码是我们重建的
半径而非输出,这就是点: 表面没有厚度,所以有
无法找到测量数据, 这里没有重叠的度量标准。

blocks.en:
Two barriers stand behind that, and neither would move for a loss weight or more data. The first
is that the corruption these models were trained to repair is a different object from a clinical
defect: a compact cluster removing 10.8 times as many surface points and differing in dispersion at
Cliff’s δ = 0.83 \delta=0.83 . The second is the output type: a surface has no thickness to recover, at a
density that could not resolve one ( Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh:
后面有两个障碍,对损失的重量或更多的数据都不会移动。 第一个
这些模型被训练去修补的腐败 与临床治疗不同
缺陷:一个紧凑的集群,去除10.8倍的表面点和分散度的差异。
克里夫(Cliff) = 0.83\delta= 0.83. 第二是输出类型:表面无厚度可回收,在
密度(图 3)

blocks.en:
How the failure presents is what makes it a trust problem. Look at the pictures and the models have
done their job: the defect is covered, the head has its shape back, and AdaPoinTr returns something
a reader would accept as a skull. Measure the same outputs and none can be put in the patient. A
diffuse cloud is its own warning; a clean cap that scores unremarkably and still cuts into bone
carries none, and that is the harder case to catch.
blocks.zh:
失败是如何呈现的 使它成为一个信任问题。 看看这些照片和模型
完成了他们的工作: 缺陷被覆盖, 头的形状还原, 和AdaPoinTr 返回的东西
读者会接受为头骨。 测量同样的输出,不能放进病人体内。 页:1
扩散的云是它自己的警告, 干净的盖子, 得分不显眼, 仍然切成骨头
不携带任何物品,这是最难捉到的。

blocks.en:
The outputs are not beyond repair. A cloud sitting roughly in the right place could be surfaced,
trimmed against the retained bone and thickened into a plate. But each step carries a threshold
whose right value differs from skull to skull, so they would be set by hand, per patient. That is
the manual work a pretrained model was meant to remove, and a pipeline needing it is not automatic. What it has to
beat is the time a specialist spends in CAD, and repairing these completions is unlikely to be
quicker.
blocks.zh:
产出并非无法修复。 大约坐落在正确位置的云可能会浮出水面
与留存的骨骼进行修剪,并加厚成板. 但每一步都有一个门槛
他们的正确价值因头骨不同而异,故他们依病人的手而排列。 这是
手动操作 一个经过预先训练的型号是用来去除的 需要它的管道不是自动的 它必须做什么
节拍是专家在CAD的时间,修复这些完成不太可能
快点

blocks.en:
Two changes follow, one to the models and one to how they are judged. Recovering thickness needs a
volumetric or implicit output, or point spacing below half the plate thickness, and a training
defect that is the clinical one. Physical acceptance has to enter the objective, and any overlap
score needs a do-nothing baseline [ 16 , 21 ] .
blocks.zh:
随后有两个变化,一个是模型,一个是如何判断模型。 回收厚度需要
体积输出或隐性输出,或盘厚度的一半以下的点间距,以及训练
缺陷就是临床缺陷 实际接受必须输入目标,任何重叠
得分需要一个无所事事的基准 [16, 21].

blocks.en:
What this does not cover is worth saying plainly. We audited released checkpoints used as they
come, so what finetuning on cranial data would buy is untested here. The acceptance criterion is
geometric and no clinician read the outputs: failing it is disqualifying, passing it would not by
itself make an implant acceptable. We also did not run a task-specific point-cloud method, which
would separate the output representation from the
pretraining [ 5 , 8 ] . And the real defects number 29, enough to show
that carved benchmarks flatter these models and not enough to settle a clinical question alone.
blocks.zh:
这不能掩盖的,是值得直言的。 我们审计了已放行的检查站
来,对颅骨数据进行微调能买到什么 未经测试 接受标准是
几何和没有临床医生读过这些产出:如果它不合格,它不会通过
它可以让植入物被接受 我们也没有使用特定任务点云方法,
将产出说明与
预训 [5, 8]. 而真正的缺陷 29号,足以显示
并且还不足以解决一个临床问题

blocks.en:
To conclude, cranial implant design looks, at first sight, like a shape completion problem. That
assumption should be treated with caution: the released shape completion foundation models we could
obtain are not trustworthy here, and an output can look like a correct reconstruction and still be
of no use in the clinic. Research towards trustworthy foundation models for medical shape
completion remains at an early stage.
blocks.zh:
最后,颅内植入设计乍一看就像形状完成问题. 那个
假设应谨慎对待:我们可以释放的形状完成基础模型
获取在此不可信, 输出可以看起来像一个正确的重建, 并且仍然是
在诊所没有用。 研究医疗形状的可靠基础模型
完成工作仍处于早期阶段。
